# A Design System

Open-source, standards-first Web Components and design tokens.

## Primary references

- Component catalogue: /#catalog
- Component contracts: /packages/components/custom-elements.json
- API snapshot: /packages/components/api-snapshot.json
- Token documentation: /docs/tokens.md
- Contribution guide: /CONTRIBUTING.md

Use the generated custom-elements metadata as the source of truth for tags, attributes, properties, slots, parts, events, and maturity.
